messages:
alex: quick sync — we have ambiguous attribution for requests coming from service accounts. SA created in org A but acting on project B; routing/quota logic is inconsistent. anyone free?

jin: on it. can you paste an example flow/token?

alex: example flow: SA created in org:acme, minting a project-scoped key that then calls hosted api with header `x-internal-project: proj-123`. right now routing prefers token.project claim, then org. but minted SA tokens sometimes lack project claim. this causes requests to fall back to org-level billing.

sam: :thinking: telemetry confirms this. ~2% of prod calls missing project claim, showing up under org default and skewing quotas/alerts.

taylor: console UX note — if we change attribution rules we should surface the "effective project" in the request detail and allow org admins to set an override/fallback. also need a migration banner.

alex: proposal: introduce an explicit `origin_project` claim at mint time. routing precedence: origin_project -> header (only if allowed) -> token.project -> org. migration: mint new tokens with origin_project; rollout behind a feature-flag per-tenant.

jin: security question — what about impersonation? if a tok is impersonated, origin_project should be the original minting project, not the impersonator. we should never let arbitrary headers override origin_project unless the SA has an "allow-header-attr" bit.

sam: agree. telemetry needs: `token_origin` (mint service id), `attr_method` (origin|header|token|org), and `resolved_project`. add those to per-request logs + cost-breakdown UI.

taylor: UX items: (1) rollout banner "Attribution is changing — X% of your calls may be reattributed" with link to docs; (2) add resolved_project column to request table; (3) admin override panel for fallback mapping.

alex: canary plan: implement claim + runtime resolver. route-policy checks `origin_project` if present and tenant feature-flag is ON. rollout to 5 tenants then 20 then everyone. fallback remains available.

jin: impl notes: token schema bump (v2 claim), update minting service, update runtime resolver and auth proxy. also need compatibility path for third-party token minting (we'll accept header-only tokens only if "allow-header-attr" is set and logged).

sam: ops guard: if resolved_project is missing AND request exceeds quota threshold, route to org fallback and fire a high-priority alert. avoid silent re-attribution for spikes.

docs-bot: docs: design doc created — https://redwood.internal/docs/sa-attribution-2026  (PR #412)

taylor: who owns the rollout runbook & customer comms?

alex: i'll draft the runbook. jin you own runtime changes; sam telemetry/alerts; taylor console + comms. i'll loop legal for billing notice. please ack and surface blockers by EOD. :thumbsup:

jin: ack. starting a branch for resolver changes.

sam: ack, i'll add telemetry fields and a dashboard tile for reattribution rate.

taylor: ack, will mock banner + UI changes and post designs in the thread.

alex: quick example token claim for the doc:```
{
  "iss": "redwood-mint",
  "sub": "sa:acme:svc-1234",
  "origin_project": "proj-123",
  "iat": 1769000000
}
```

jin: nice. one more edge: rotating tokens — ensure origin_project persists across rotation or we risk losing attribution when tokens refresh.

sam: good call. persist claim in secret store metadata and re-embed on rotate.

alex: cool. i'll assemble the runbook + migration checklist today. thanks all.
